mapper.sql: id, question, expected_refs, match_level, kb_ids, audience, expected_keywords, remark, enabled, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO rag_eval_case (question, expected_refs, match_level, kb_ids, audience, expected_keywords, remark, enabled, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{question}, #{expectedRefs}, COALESCE(#{matchLevel}, 'chunk'), #{kbIds}, COALESCE(#{audience}, 'all'), #{expectedKeywords}, #{remark}, COALESCE(#{enabled}, 1), NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM rag_eval_case WHERE enabled = 1
AND (audience = #{audience} OR audience = 'all')
ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM rag_eval_case WHERE enabled = 1
